usage: music-tagger write-stats [-h] [--from FROM_FILE] [--root ROOT]
                                [--dry-run] [--clear] [--allow-decrease]
                                [--library LIBRARY] [--log LOG | --no-log]

Write ratings and play counts from a statistics snapshot to audio files.
Favorites are not written.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --from FROM_FILE   Statistics snapshot (default:
                     /mnt/synology/media/music/stats.json).
  --root ROOT        Library root to resolve paths (default:
                     /mnt/synology/media/music).
  --dry-run          Show what would change, and the rewrite cost, without
                     writing.
  --clear            Clear the rating of files the snapshot marks unrated (0).
                     Without it they are kept.
  --allow-decrease   Write play counts lower than the file's count. Without it
                     they are kept.
  --library LIBRARY  Navidrome library to write, by name or numeric id; songs
                     in other libraries are skipped (default: 'Music
                     Library'). 'all' writes every library.
  --log LOG          Append changes to this log file (default:
                     $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                     tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log           Do not write the change log.
